detailedInAppNotifications: Sound notifications for in-app messages that appear from the top right, including both regular updates and milestone achievements.
detailedMilestoneSounds: Special sound effects that play when you achieve significant milestones or accomplishments in the app.
detailedClickSounds: Audible feedback for clicks and button interactions throughout the application.
detailedQuizSoundEffects: Sound effects specifically designed to enhance your quiz-taking experience.
updateFailedDescription: Failed to save sound settings. Please try again.
reEnableTooltip: You can try to re-enable notifications to receive in-app notifications if not working.
enableTooltip: Please enable notifications to receive in-app notifications.
description: You're missing out on important updates about quizzes, tournaments and new content.
pwaNotice: You're using the installed app version. App notification permissions are managed separately from browser permissions.

instructions.android:
Click the lock/site info icon in address bar
Select 'Site Settings'
Find Notifications and select 'Allow'
Also check Chrome settings > Site settings > Notifications
instructions.ios:
Open Settings app
Scroll down to Safari
Tap Notifications
Toggle to allow notifications for this site
instructions.mac:
Click the lock/site info icon in address bar
Select 'Site Settings'
Find Notifications and select 'Allow'
You may also need to check System Preferences > Notifications
instructions.generic:
Click the lock/site info icon in your browser's address bar
Select 'Site Settings' or 'Permissions'
Find Notifications and change to 'Allow'
instructions.androidPWA:
Open your device Settings
Go to Apps (or Applications)
Find and tap on Rapid Recap
Select Notifications
Toggle to allow notifications
instructions.iosPWA:
Open your device Settings
Scroll down and find Rapid Recap
Tap on Notifications
Toggle to allow notifications
instructions.genericPWA:
Open your device Settings
Find the Applications or Apps section
Locate Rapid Recap
Enable notifications in the app settings
